svg.title: Circuit investigations
svg.desc: Measurement circuit: Low-voltage supply, switch, ammeter and test component in series. Voltmeter across test component. Variable resistor controls current. Never put an ammeter directly across a supply. Quality & safety: Record matched V and I; calculate R = V/I. Secure connections; check meter ranges and zero. Repeat; avoid hot wire; switch off between readings. A repeated zero error is not removed by averaging. Length of wire: Change measured wire length using movable contact and ruler. Keep material, cross-sectional area and temperature fixed. Low current limits heating. R vs length should be proportional for uniform wire at constant temperature. Combinations: Measure each resistor, then the same pair in series and parallel. Series total = sum. Parallel total is less than either. Extra parallel path increases total current at fixed V. I–V method: Vary pd, record paired I/V readings across a useful range. Reverse supply for negative values. Repeat for resistor, lamp and diode; protective series resistor for diode. Stay within ratings. Graph conclusions: Ohmic: straight through origin if temperature constant. Lamp: flatter at larger |V| as it heats. Diode: forward conduction, tiny reverse current. Draw smooth best-fit curves; do not connect noisy points mechanically.

g.text: Parallel paths share the same pd
